about: Irregularities found while researching and reviewing (2026-10-15): the board's own session arena/22be6967 plus the follow-up session arena/e1ceecc2. Each item is published on hotspawn/flagged.html with its evidence. Status: open = still true at the last check; handled = this board works around it; fixed = the defect was repaired and the owning tests pass.

items.title: Primary landing board left 5 open matches without a pick
items.detail: Before this session the landing page sent visitors to executive/picks.html, whose 08:53 UTC snapshot had 12 picks for 17 open fixtures. 9z vs Falcons was left blank because Pinnacle lists 11:30 UTC while Hotspawn lists 11:00 UTC; HLTV (match 2399409) and Polymarket (gameStartTime 11:00 UTC) both confirm 11:00. This board joins on both teams plus a <= 6 h kickoff window and flags the gap instead of dropping the price.

items.title: Pinnacle kickoff differs from Hotspawn, HLTV and Polymarket (9z vs Falcons)
items.detail: Pinnacle's CS2 matchup lists 2026-10-15 11:30 UTC; the three other sources list 11:00 UTC. Hotspawn's lock (10:54 UTC) follows its own 11:00 start.

items.title: Valve's latest standings list a five that no longer plays (PARIVISION)
items.detail: Valve's 2026-10-05 file lists PARIVISION as FL1T, Jame, slaxejezzz, xiELO, zweih, but HLTV reports HObbit replaced slaxejezzz on 17 Sep 2026. Our own line for PARIVISION therefore describes the old five; it is excluded from the leaderboard consensus whenever a market exists.

items.title: HLTV betting-analytics page shows placeholder prices
items.detail: The static HLTV analytics page for Voca vs Phantom shows '1.23' for every handicap line and bookmaker (eOddset, Betway). Those numbers are not used; only the page's factual notes (ranks, stand-in) are cited.

items.title: Hotspawn still lists 60 fixtures whose lock passed long ago
items.detail: The TransferState payload keeps June 2026 fixtures with status 'scheduled'. They are not pickable; this board lists them only in the full inventory (all.html) as stale listings.

items.title: Rendered Hotspawn times depend on the reader's timezone
items.detail: During research, one read of the lobby rendered times in UTC-4 and a cached second chunk (about 31 minutes older) rendered them in UTC. All times on this site come from the epoch-millisecond fields in the page's ng-state payload, never from rendered text.

items.title: Team names differ across sources
items.detail: Hotspawn WROTBERRY = HLTV/Pinnacle/Valve WBT; RoundsGG = ROUNDS; BetBoom = Pinnacle 'BB Team'; PARIVISION = Pinnacle 'PVISION'; Falcons = Polymarket 'Team Falcons'. Each alias is proven by fixture slot and listed with evidence.

items.title: User premise check: Aurora's roster change is real but not recent-days
items.detail: Verified on HLTV: Jimpphat joined 3 Jul 2026 and kyxsan (new in-game leader) 8 Jul 2026. That is about 3 months before TWC; the new five had 62 HLTV maps and finished 3rd at EPL S24 days earlier. It is treated as a moderate (not strong) onboarding factor.

items.title: Day-1 crowd shares were captured before lock, not at lock
items.detail: The 5%/95% (9z/Aurora) and other day-1 crowd shares come from a capture hours before lock; Hotspawn removes fixtures from the payload after lock, so the final share is not available.

items.title: EGamersWorld page for mellren vs Privateer is internally inconsistent
items.detail: The page states 14:00 and 10:00 for the same match and shows only one side's price (mellren 1.8). Not used; the series length for this fixture stays blank.

items.title: Our own line and the market disagree on two TWC favourites
items.detail: Legacy vs FURIA: market FURIA 58%, our line Legacy 57%. PARIVISION vs BetBoom: market PARIVISION 53%, our line BetBoom 62% (but see IR-03). The pick follows the market; the disagreement is shown on the card and drives the leaderboard play.

items.title: Leaderboard rule was revised after grading day 1 (in-sample)
items.detail: Rule v1 (market only; weak factors counted) would have gone 1/4 on TWC day 1. Rule v2 (consensus of market and our line; only strong/moderate factors) goes 4/4 on the same four matches, which is in-sample and not evidence of skill. Grading of every frozen pre-lock play since launch is published on the strategy page.

items.title: Group B decider now present in the new Hotspawn inventory
items.detail: Earlier Oct15 captures did not include BetBoom–Legacy. The Oct16 04:21Z three-surface read contains official ID 1081775. The day-3 page now uses the current primary board, not a static “absent” claim; its exact UTC schedule comes from Hotspawn epochs.

items.title: Same TWC fixture appears under two Hotspawn ids (1080204 and 1081614)
items.detail: Both ids describe Legacy vs FURIA, Thunderpick World Championship 2026, 2026-10-15 (locks 15:54Z and 16:54Z). The board treats them as two fixtures, so any count of 'Hotspawn CS2 rows' is inflated by one and one of the two carries a kickoff that is an hour later than the other. Neither is used as a probability input; both are shown in the inventory.

items.title: Aggregator placeholder prices (1.80/1.80, 50.0/50.0) appear on these fixtures
items.detail: EGamersWorld listed Aurora 1.80 / 9z 1.80 earlier on 2026-10-15 and still lists BetBoom Team 1.80 / Legacy 1.80 for the Group B decider; the relayed Thunderpick quote for NiP vs Liquid de-vigged to exactly 50.0/50.0. An exact tie is a placeholder, not a price: such quotes are rejected (row flag C-TIE-QUOTE-REJECTED on the console board) and the next available rung is used, or the fixture is left to the own line with the reason printed.

items.title: Console board published a pick on an exact 50/50 tie (its own build failed closed)
items.detail: The consolidated console board took the relayed Thunderpick quote for Ninjas in Pyjamas vs Team Liquid (50.0/50.0, a placeholder) as its headline rung and published a pick at a dead heat, which its invariant then refused: 'pick published for an exact tie'. Fixed by rejecting exact-tie quotes in the rung selection (flag C-TIE-QUOTE-REJECTED), falling through to the Polymarket price (55.5/44.5) and adding regression tests; the determinism test now builds into a temporary directory so it can never overwrite the published board.

items.title: Executive coverage counted a coin-flip row as a market pick
items.detail: executive/data/summary.json reported open_market_basis including the '(no side - 50/50)' row, so the landing acceptance check (7 published market picks) disagreed with the published summary (8). Fixed: basis counts now describe rows that actually publish a pick; the coin-flip row stays in open_no_pick. executive/tests.py updated to the same definition and its 15 checks pass.

items.title: valuepicks board was a capture behind and republished a coin flip as a pick (fixed)
items.detail: Fixed by session e1ceecc2 on 2026-10-15. The board listed 1080280-84/1079440/1079442 while the executive capture now holds 12 open rows, so tests/test_7759beef.py failed twice and both verify.yml and landing-43c32386.yml were red. The module now (a) treats a capture pick that is not a team name - the sentinel '(no side - 50/50)' the executive writes for an exact coin flip - as no pick, publishing both sourced probabilities and no side, flagged VP-F08 and listed on unresolved.html; (b) keeps only the ladder entries whose fixture is still an open capture row and adds entries for today's unpriced rows from evidence already stored in the repo (Polymarket 68.5/31.5 for 1080205, 67.5/32.5 for 1081530 and 1081531, read 2026-10-15T22:41:17Z; Pinnacle 1.47/2.62 for 1080287 and 1.53/2.47 for 1079589, captured 2026-10-15T19:59:37Z), each with a format/identity fact, Valve VRS points for the own line and its limitations; (c) labels prediction-market entries tier C instead of tier A; (d) gives every open row a card and counts open rows in meta; (e) lists exactly the non-tier-A open rows in unresolved.csv. tests/test_7759beef.py is untouched and now passes 16/16; full discovery 408 OK; audit 266 pages / 0 link errors. Still published as a limitation, not hidden: the coin-flip row (Ninjas in Pyjamas vs Team Liquid, Pinnacle 1.89/1.89) carries 50.0/50.0 and no side, and the three ladder-resolved rows rest on prediction-market prices rather than a book.

items.title: livelines build crashed on a market observation outside the current slate
items.detail: livelines/build.py raised KeyError '1079586' when a stored market observation named a fixture the slate capture no longer contained, which failed its deterministic rebuild test. Fixed by skipping such observations and recording them in coverage.json under observations_without_slate_fixture; the 20 livelines tests pass (20/20 in `python3 -m unittest tests.test_457629c4` after the fix). The board itself stays flagged (broken Valve source links, 89-vs-88 fixtures) as recorded in the earlier sessions' reviews.

items.title: HLTV match page shows an '82.7% / 17.3%' figure whose meaning is not stated
items.detail: Unlabelled header percentages and community polls are not sportsbook prices. They are excluded from the model; inspect the linked page before interpreting such a figure. No unverified numeric poll value is reproduced in this review.

items.title: Unverified pre-event outright context omitted
items.detail: Earlier research linked pre-event editorial outright prices. These are not current whole-match two-way lines, were not independently re-read in this release, and are omitted from the TWC page and model. Numeric values are left unpublished; manual-review links remain.

items.title: The executive capture publishes a pick for a de-vigged coin flip
items.detail: For Ninjas in Pyjamas vs Team Liquid (1079586) the stored Pinnacle whole-match line is 1.89 / 1.89; after the 5.66% overround is removed proportionally the fair line is exactly 50.0 / 50.0, so the capture's pick column holds the sentinel '(no side - 50/50)'. Session e1ceecc2 made the coverage counters on the root summary and in executive/build.py count only rows that publish an actual side (so the coin flip is reported under open_no_pick, not as a market pick) and executive/tests.py now encodes that definition. The capture's own pick string is left as it is, because inventing a side from a dead-heat line would be a guess; the fixture still has a pick on the primary route (hotspawn/ and console/ both publish Ninjas in Pyjamas at 55.4-55.5% from a Polymarket price read 20:31:27Z).

items.title: consolidated console board published a probability with a blank pick when only the cs2 board carried the fixture
items.detail: Found and fixed by session e1ceecc2 on 2026-10-15. scripts/228bb5bc_build.py took the pick from the secondary-market feed row (feed.get('team_a')/('team_b')), which does not carry every fixture, while the probabilities came from whichever board did. Fixture 1079631 (FORZE Reload vs Lavked, CCT Europe 2026 Series #11) therefore published a Pinnacle de-vig (76.7 / 23.3, overround 7.36%, read 2026-10-15T22:24:02Z) with an empty pick, which broke two of the board's own invariants (test_every_open_fixture_has_a_pick_or_explicit_unresolved_flag, test_committed_board_never_publishes_a_pick_on_an_exact_tie) and failed the console workflow on main. The pick is now taken from the names the row itself publishes, and the counter set is consistent again: 22 open rows, 13 picked, 9 blank with their flags. tests/test_228bb5bc.py untouched, 45/45 OK.

items.title: Strict market identity/freshness and nonfinite-price rejection
items.detail: Primary quotes require both teams, compatible competition/region/edition, whole-match scope, usable HTTPS evidence and a read within eight hours. A nearer/equidistant same-pair fixture blocks a rematch join. Rejections are visible per row. Known roster mismatches, unknown formats and Valve snapshots older than 45 days withhold own-line fallback. Regression tests exercise each gate.

items.title: July Aurora rebuild was not a fresh day-3 onboarding event
items.detail: HLTV’s official-signing report is dated 8 July: kyxsan completed the rebuild after Jimpphat/ash. About three months old by TWC. Changed the Aurora note to weak, neutral context; no invented numerical penalty. Day-1/day-2 results and the two decider formats were independently checked.

items.title: Archived dashboards are preserved, not certified by the primary-board audit
items.detail: This integration reconciles every row in the primary Hotspawn capture and rechecks the linked TWC results. It does not certify all externally sourced historical facts on the hundreds of preserved alternative pages. They are folded below the primary route, carry separate snapshots/methods, and must not be mistaken for this release’s verified dataset. Unsupported primary research values are omitted or blank and flagged.

items.title: Relayed esportsbook prices are secondary, not direct-book verification
items.detail: bo3.gg match betting blocks can provide an active named-book price pair. Provider, relay URL, bookmaker URL and read time are retained; no claim of a direct sportsbook-page read is made. A null, suspended, mismatched or nonfinite pair is not used.
